select s.csr_id, s.csr_no, s.csr_rev, s.notify_req::text as notify_req_json from qms_cust_csr s where s.cust_id = #{custId} and s.use_yn = 'Y' and s.effective_from <= #{on} and s.notify_req <> '{}'::jsonb and (not exists (select 1 from qms_cust_csr_target t where t.csr_id = s.csr_id)
